units.rawText: Your men are very "keen", Python. How did you train them to have such indomitable spirit?

units.rawText: Still, it's useless. The heavy mech that we've deployed isn't for fun and games. It might only be a test unit, but the Balmung is a killing machine in every sense of the word. Also...

units.rawText: Is this what you meant by a mixed unit of humans and Dolls? Hahahahaha! They're undisciplined and disorganized, are they supposed to be the future of warfare?

units.rawText: They've only been trained for less than three months.

spans.text: They've only been trained for less than three months.

units.rawText: Are you making excuses for your upcoming loss of employment? The "Instructor Python" I knew only needed a month to make a new man out of me—

spans.text: Are you making excuses for your upcoming loss of employment? The "Instructor Python" I knew only needed a month to make a new man out of me—

units.rawText: Don't give me that nonsense, you know very well this is hardly a fair instance of the Military Games.

units.rawText: ...Yes, that's right. It's not fair, but who cares?

units.rawText: I dislike Dolls. My comrades dislike Dolls. Even my superiors dislike Dolls.
units.displayText: I dislike Dolls. My comrades dislike Dolls. Even my superiors dislike Dolls.

spans.text: I dislike Dolls. My comrades dislike Dolls. Even my superiors dislike Dolls.

units.rawText: Nobody likes Dolls. Isn't the Balmung better? It doesn't have all those nonsensical thoughts and it certainly doesn't try to overstep its bounds, thinking it can order humans around.
